production_patch: Targets JSphGpu_ker.h/.cu and JSphGpuSingle.cpp only. Append optional float*kplastic=NULL,float*kplasticdk=NULL after porojpre on PeriodicDuplicateSymplectic; forward through the existing kernel and both varspre launches. Conditional owner copies precede the existing predictor-array block. GpuSingle supplies existing Kplasticg/KplasticDkg only for MaterialReturn1; otherwise defaultNULL preserves the old branch. No array, neighbour pass, periodic selection/position/cell algorithm, Verlet path or material equation is added/changed.
reason: Actual periodic images are recreated before force/material stages. The old Symplectic duplicator copied sigma/J/p but omitted both persistent plastic history and its diagnostic accumulator. A mode1 material return on an image could therefore read an uninitialized/stale kappa despite valid native owners. Copy from the actual list-selected source slot, including an already created image for a later axis/corner; do not assume every list index is a normal native owner.

component: Fresh upl_material_periodic_GPU_component_r1.cpp calls the real cusph::PeriodicDuplicateSymplectic wrapper, not a copied CUDA kernel. Four conditions: varspre false/true crossed with omitted optional history pointers versus both present. Each runs3 ordered wrappers: positive/negative X images, chained positive/negative Z corners from those images, then another X copy from a corner. Existing real CTE cell coding is initialized for an8x1x8 exact dyadic domain. Distinct prescribed scalar/tensor/J/p inputs, zero physical solver, no material return.
chain_witness: After first-axis images are made, change native-owner history; a later corner must still copy its immediate image's earlier history. Before the last copy, change that corner's history again. This separates true source-slot copying from incorrectly resolving every copy to owner0. These are explicit component-only writes between kernel calls, not a physical integration scheme.
checks: Every call checks all8 slots of all existing defined arrays and both history arrays using per-member float/double bits. Slots6/7 are untouched tails. Omitted-pointer conditions must leave history destinations at their sentinels (except declared host source writes); enabled conditions must exactly copy source kappa/dk, including corners. Known scalar-only native layout sizes are static-asserted. Actual legacy-array snapshots exclude the2new history arrays and must be byte-identical between optionalNULL andON for each predictor-array variant. This is a same-new-wrapper branch comparison, not a claim about an unexecuted old binary.
